summary: Fifteen selected items form a coherent digest. The dominant thread is OpenAI pausing frontier/RL training on alignment grounds, covered from three distinct angles (CEO Altman, official OpenAI account, and reporter Alex Heath naming the Astra model and misalignment signals). GLM-5.3 is covered by vendor release plus independent benchmark, a valid distinct-angle pair. AIDO virtual-cell has genbioai selected with ericxing held as a same-story reserve. Two Qwen3.8-27B items address different events (local DFlash inference speedup vs Harvey legal benchmark placement). Remaining items (Anthropic protein binder research, DeepMind matmul exponent, Berd open-source agent tool, Economist AI-homework study, xAI agent adoption, llm-jp-4 33B release, Anthropic supervoting/IPO) are self-contained and non-redundant. No context-dependent special-account replies; no replacements needed.
